newsitem.title: USA: Harken begins testing of Torcaz-2 well.
newsitem.headline: Harken begins testing of Torcaz-2 well.

text.p: Harken Energy Corp said Thursday the Torcaz No. 2 well has been successfully completed and production testing has begun.

The well, located on Harken's Rio Negro Prospect in the Middle Magdalena Basin of Colombia, was drilled to a depth of 8,488 feet as planned. In mid-August, the company said it expected to have production results by the end of August.

Harken said the geological appraisal of the drilling and logging data exceeds the estimates of ResTech, a Houston-based petrophysical firm engaged in 1994 to evaluate the Rio Negro field prior to drilling.
Harken said log analysis shows substantially greater net productive thickness and higher oil saturations than expected.

"We were very encouraged by the drilling and logging results; however, the real success of this well cannot be measured until we complete the production testing phase," Harken said. "So far, the drilling phase of the Torcaz No. 2 well has yielded better than anticipated results."
